findings.summary: Persisted channel selection is capped before joined-channel validation
findings.details: bulkSetChannelPolicies reads sourceChannels with only organizationKey constrained and take(101), while joined/active filtering and the 100-channel envelope are enforced later inside buildBulkPolicyPlan. If an organization has more than 101 non-joined or otherwise non-active channel rows ahead of joined rows in the by_organization_membership_state index range, the mutation can omit valid joined channels from the planner and return ChannelNotJoined for channels admins are supposed to bulk-select, or miss the 101st active joined row needed to enforce CapacityExceeded. The capability must query/validate the complete bounded joined-channel set, not a mixed membership prefix.

findings.summary: Immutable policy epoch planning is based on a truncated organization policy page
findings.details: The persisted mutation derives next policyEpoch/deliveryGeneration and deactivates active pointers from at most 500 organization-created policy rows. S04-T04 requires rollback/change to create a new immutable epoch without rewriting the prior one and to move the active pointer based on prior policy state. Once an organization accumulates more than 500 policy rows, the current active row or highest epoch for a changed channel can fall outside this page, causing duplicate/lower epochs, missed idempotent retry detection, or multiple active policies for the same channel.
